title: CONCATENATEX writes a BLANK value as an empty string and keeps its delimiter

source.quote: A BLANK value of Expression becomes an empty string, but CONCATENATEX still adds the delimiter.
source.supports: the page gives this expression and its result, 1,,3

notes: No order expression is given, as on the page. The page also says the order is then not guaranteed, so an engine that iterates the constructor in another order would differ.
